items.stem: What capability does EDR add beyond traditional signature antivirus?

options.text: Behavioural detection, investigation and response across endpoints
options.rationale: Correct: EDR detects behaviours and supports investigation/response.

options.text: It only scans files against a signature list
options.rationale: That describes traditional antivirus, not EDR's added value.

options.text: It removes the need for any patching
It makes endpoints immune to all attacks

items.explanation: Correct: EDR adds behavioural detection, investigation and response.

items.stem: Which TWO hardening measures reduce endpoint risk? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Removing local administrator rights from standard users
options.rationale: Correct: least privilege limits what malware can do.

options.text: Keeping the operating system and applications patched
Disabling all logging on the endpoint
options.rationale: Disabling logging removes detection and investigation data.

options.text: Giving every user full admin to avoid prompts

items.explanation: Correct: removing admin rights and patching both reduce endpoint risk.

items.stem: A laptop shows signs of active compromise. What is the most appropriate first response?

options.text: Isolate it from the network while preserving it for investigation
options.rationale: Correct: isolation contains spread while keeping evidence.

options.text: Immediately reformat it to be safe
options.rationale: Reformatting destroys evidence needed to understand the incident.

options.text: Leave it connected to watch what happens
options.rationale: Leaving it connected risks spread and data loss.

options.text: Unplug the power without any process
options.rationale: Abruptly powering off can destroy volatile evidence.

items.explanation: Correct: isolate the endpoint while preserving it for investigation.
